name: ERP/Baumgarte Collision Resolution
definition: A collision resolution method that uses Signed Distance Fields (SDF) to determine depth and normal for correcting object penetration. It removes a fraction of penetration per step (Baumgarte stabilization) and kills inward normal velocity.
summary: ERP/Baumgarte Collision Resolution is a constraint-based method for terrain physics that combines velocity damping with proportional-derivative-like impulses to prevent tunneling and stabilize contact without excessive jitter.
